items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: we played in concert, and on the concert -- the fair -- with Marian Anderson

ctx.x: So anyway, I went down to Haiti from then for about five straight years; every year I used to go down there and teach. My first stint was three months. The next time I went down to Haiti, they were having their centennial down there from all of the islands, and I took the Billy Taylor

quartet with me and went down there. And we played in concert, and on the concert -- the fair -- with Marian Anderson, and we had, you know, the reception from the Haitian government with Marian Anderson, and we were all there.
Did you ever get to know the great Haitian Fenlan, a great writer?
